big_case.notes: An eve-of-execution Florida stay application. It turns on a clemency due-process theory under the Woodard concurrence that lower courts have repeatedly rejected. The stakes are irreversible for the applicant, but the Court denied the stay and cert together in an unsigned order with no noted writing, so the decision has little doctrinal or systemic reach.
